title: AdventureZ - Fresh Animations
description: Fresh Animations-style custom mob animations for AdventureZ. 20 mobs brought to life with smooth CEM walk cycles, weapon-aware attacks, and distinct personalities. OptiFine and EMF compatible.
body:
# AdventureZ - Fresh Animations

**Fresh Animations-style custom mob animations for the AdventureZ mod.** Every walk cycle, every attack swing, every idle pose rebuilt from scratch with CEM (Custom Entity Models) to match the smoothness and personality of [Fresh Animations](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/fresh-animations). No more robotic stock poses - AdventureZ mobs finally move like they mean it.

## What it does

Out of the box, AdventureZ mobs use the default minecraft model with minimal procedural animation. This pack replaces 20 of them with hand-crafted CEM animations:

- **Smooth walk/run cycles** - arms swing, legs stride, bodies sway, with per-mob tempo based on real movement speed
- **Weapon-aware attacks** - skeletons draw bows like vanilla skeletons; soul reapers switch between bow and sword; necromancers cast without a melee swing
- **Personality poses** - shamans hold their staff, orcs hunch forward, fungi bob, rhinos snort, mammoths wave their trunks
- **Hurt reactions** - a quick recoil on damage so hits feel impactful

## Covered mobs (20)

Humanoids: **orc**, **shaman**, **skeleton_vanguard**, **soul_reaper**, **necromancer**, **summoner**, **wither_puppet**

Fungi & organics: **brown_fungus**, **red_fungus**, **the_eye**

Golems: **blackstone_golem**, **mini_blackstone_golem**, **amethyst_golem**, **blaze_guardian**

Beasts: **desert_rhino**, **piglin_beast**, **deer**, **iguana**, **enderwarthog**, **mammoth**

## Compatibility

- Minecraft **1.20.1** (pack_format 15, supported_formats 9-46 so it loads on older/newer versions too)
- AdventureZ **1.4.x** (tested) - should work on any version that keeps the same render layer names
- Safe to stack with Fresh Animations itself (they cover different entity sets)
- Texture packs for AdventureZ mobs remain compatible - this pack only changes models/animations, not textures

## Credits

Built on top of the **Fresh Animations** style by FreshLX (not a direct fork - independent CEM implementation referencing the FA vanilla templates).

AdventureZ mod by Jack Plays YT.


Used in the [Legends Reborn: Medieval (LRM)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/legends-reborn-medieval) modpack.
